# proxmox_node_status_command (Resource)

Runs `reboot` or `shutdown` on a node through `POST /nodes/{node}/status`. Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_status_command" "reboot" {
  node         = "pve-1"
  command      = "reboot"
  wait_seconds = 120
  triggers     = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) `reboot` or `shutdown`.
- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to run the command again.

### Optional

- `wait_seconds` (Number) After the command, wait up to this many seconds for the node to answer again (0 disables the wait).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<command>/<node>` form.
